parties.respondent: Sri Prabha Ranjan Debbarma AND OTHERS

summary: Land ownership dispute over 'Khosh Mahal' property; contested will and title claim; validity of lease and conveyance; burden of proof in property cases; reliance on Deed of Patta (Exhibit-12) and Ekrarnama (Exhibit-5); reversal of trial court decree by High Court; standard of proof preponderance of evidence; state land reforms act implications; final determination of title and possession.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court judgment set aside; trial court decree upheld.
